1) Week 0 (this week): Complete security questionnaire, exchange network details, and sign mutual NDA if needed.
2) Week 1: VPC peering + test keys; baseline perf on synthetic dataset.
3) Week 2–3: Run production-like workload; iterate on batching/quantization settings.

Trial success criteria (concrete):
1) Latency: p95 <= 250ms on 99th percentile of workload shapes provided by Atlas

Telemetry fields we need (minimal): request_id, model_id, input_token_count, output_token_count, latency_ms, status_code, kv_cache_hit (if applicable), prompt_version. We’ll provide a JSON schema and a sample event.
